summary: Regression test of RideTrackingPage refactor (split into RideTrackingMap, DriverInfoCard, RideActions) + TaxiBiddingPage useCallback wrap. RideTrackingPage works correctly (renders, map+markers, status bar, fare details, cancel modal with 7 reasons, cancellation flow). TaxiBiddingPage is COMPLETELY BROKEN: shows 'Uncaught runtime error: Cannot access fetchEstimate before initialization' (TDZ ReferenceError).

minor.issue: Returns duplicate 'Autre raison' entries (visible duplicate in cancel modal + React warning 'Encountered two children with the same key'). 7 reasons returned but two are labeled 'Autre raison'.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL ReferenceError at render: 'Cannot access fetchEstimate before initialization'. Page is fully broken (white screen + dev overlay). Root cause: useEffect at line 53 lists `fetchEstimate` in its dependency array (line 58) but `const fetchEstimate = useCallback(...)` is declared later at line 69. JS const declarations are in TDZ until their definition line, so reading `fetchEstimate` while building the deps array at line 58 throws synchronously during the initial render.
React 'duplicate key' warning when rendering cancel-reasons list. Need to use a unique key (e.g., reason.id) or de-duplicate the array returned by the backend.

integration_issues.issue: Whole feature unusable - users see runtime error overlay instead of the form. Cannot enter pickup/dropoff, cannot trigger fare estimate, cannot submit bid.

critical_code_review_comments: TaxiBiddingPage.js lines 53-91: useEffect at 53 closes over `fetchEstimate` (declared at line 69 with const+useCallback). Because the deps array is evaluated synchronously while the function body of the component runs, this triggers a ReferenceError on every initial render. The eslint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps fix the user wanted is correct in spirit, but the function MUST be defined before its consumers.
RideTrackingPage.js: refactor looks clean (431 lines, sub-components in /ride-tracking/). No regression detected in the actual ride flow. Good split.
RideActions.jsx (CancelRideModal): When rendering cancel-reasons list, use `key={reason.id}` (not the array index or label) and ideally de-duplicate by id.

rca of the issue: TaxiBiddingPage.js TDZ ReferenceError: In strict-mode JavaScript, `const` and `let` bindings are hoisted but remain in the 'Temporal Dead Zone' until execution reaches the declaration line. The function body of TaxiBiddingPage runs top-to-bottom on every render. At line 53 React calls useEffect(fn, deps). The deps array `[pickup, dropoff, vehicleType, fetchEstimate]` is evaluated synchronously at line 58, but `fetchEstimate` is not yet defined (its useCallback declaration is at line 69). Hence: `ReferenceError: Cannot access 'fetchEstimate' before initialization`. The page never finishes its first render and React renders the error overlay. Reproduction: GET /taxi-bidding as logged-in user. Mitigation: simply move the `const fetchEstimate = useCallback(...)` block to line ~52 (just above the first useEffect that uses it). No other logic change is needed; the deps arrays are correct.
